name: DividedSplitting.theta_productForm
summary: Apply DividedSplitting.theta_pointForm, split the kernel of I_n = I_N ⊕ I_m into a product of two kernels (modKernelI_block), and expand the indicator of the glued condition as a sum over the congruence group (IsGlued.indicator_eq_sum); the tame character and the Cartan product factor accordingly.

steps.claim: Write the kernel modulo M²Q through the factored datum (modDatum_factor), split it along ε into the product of the kernels of I_N and I_m (modKernelI_block) with b·b' = O.b (hb), move the lifts of the congruence group into the point (modKernel_mul_Kf_left), and use linearity in the datum (modKernelBilin).
steps.lean:
simp_rw [modKernel, ← modDatum_factor levelModulus_ideal_le, ← modKernel.eq_1, ← modKernelI_block
    V.ε, hb, modKernel_mul_Kf_left, ← modKernelBilin_apply, ← LinearMap.sum_apply, ← map_sum]

steps.claim: Rewrite the indicator of the glued condition as the sum over Y (H.indicator_eq_sum), unfold the column datum, use that liftMod Y reduces to 1 at the chosen places, and evaluate the tame character on determinants (apply_det_eq_prod for the weight of rankTwist).
steps.lean:
simp [← ite_and, ← submatrix_map, columnDatum, reduceAt_liftMod_congruenceGroup,
    H.indicator_eq_sum, O.hasWeight.hasWeight_rankTwist.apply_det_eq_prod O.apart.1 O.tame_eq_one]

steps.claim: Unfold the finite product and the determinant of reductions, using the identity of step 7.
The character charOfTamePart of ψ at x is the product over the places of O.levelModulus 2 of ψ at the residues, reindexed by the places of O (finprod_comp_equiv along the injective place family).
steps.lean:
show charOfTamePart _ _ _ = ∏ᶠ j, O.ψ _ (levelResidueAt j _) from (finprod_comp_equiv
    (.trans (.ofInjective _ O.apart.1) (Set.equivOfEq places_levelModulus.symm))).symm]

steps.claim: The factors at the chosen places are 1 and at the twist places the lifts reduce to 1 (Kf.reduceAt_eq_one_of_atPlace, atPlace_twistPlace_eq_one, liftMod_mem_supportedOn).
The block condition on the rows ε(inl ·) is the condition of the column datum: by genResidue_smul_eq_iff with V.fixedEmb (stackOverGenScalar, fromRows_ext_iff).
steps.lean:
intros; rw [← Function.id_comp id, ← submatrix_submatrix, submatrix_map,
    (V.genResidue_smul_eq_iff _ V.fixedEmb).1
    (by simp_all [stackOverGenScalar, ← submatrix_map, fromRows_ext_iff])]; simp [inclMatrix]

steps.claim: The harmonic polynomial of the conjugate Cartan product is the product of the letter polynomials of ȳ and η̄ (mixedCartan_mulVec_cartanProduct, letterPoly, rowSubst, fockLetters), using step 10.1.
steps.lean:
simp [show star _ = _ from map_cartanProduct V.low.1 V.low.2 _ _ _ conj, V.low, HasColumnsBelow,
    AuxPair.harmonicPoly, mixedCartan_mulVec_cartanProduct, letterPoly,
    rowSubst, fockLetters, inclMatrix, MvPolynomial.rename_bind₁, MvPolynomial.bind₁_bind₁]; rfl

steps.claim: The conjugate of the Cartan product of y and η is the Cartan product of the conjugates (map_cartanProduct with the column conditions V.low); with it the simp set closes the goal.
steps.lean:
show star _ = _ from map_cartanProduct V.low.1 V.low.2 _ _ _ conj, V.low, HasColumnsBelow,
    AuxPair.harmonicPoly, mixedCartan_mulVec_cartanProduct, letterPoly,
    rowSubst, fockLetters, inclMatrix, MvPolynomial.rename_bind₁, MvPolynomial.bind₁_bind₁]; rfl
